rationale: This is the stable content-addressed identity for a planned shard and is referenced by initial_waves[].shard_digests. Keeping it lets the plan name deterministic wave membership without embedding or recomputing shard structure at every consumer.
alternatives: derive from the ordered trial digests, but that makes the shard identity and wave references depend on a duplicated canonicalization contract
replace with an ordinal, but ordinals are less durable under plan inspection and do not provide content identity
simplestChoice: Keep shard_digest as the required shard identity.
